resources.string: Not from CREA? Use your Google account: you get a private folder in your Drive and the public catalog. AI and natural voices are only for CREA accounts.
Your private “CREA Reader” folder in your Google Drive: only you see it. Books you upload from the app with “Upload to Drive” follow you to any device where you connect this account.
Add an EPUB or PDF in My library and tap “Upload to Drive”: it is saved in your private folder. Files you put in the folder by hand on the Drive website are not visible in the app.
%1$s is a CREA account. Connect it with “Connect CREA account”.
%1$s is not a CREA account (@creanicaragua.org). Connect it with “Use another Google account”.
Your folder has no books yet. In My library, open a book and tap “Upload to Drive” to have it on all your devices.
